item.title: Login Mahasiswa & SSO Kampus
item.prompt:
Halaman Login Akun Mahasiswa untuk aplikasi CampusFolio.
Desain antarmuka mobile modern bertema Academic Modernist yang profesional, bersih, dan elegan.
Hindari emoji/emote kasual atau tidak relevan, gunakan ikon Material Symbols Outlined.
Elemen halaman:
- Header dengan logo CampusFolio dan info versi kampus terverifikasi
- Judul: "Masuk ke CampusFolio", Subjudul: "Akses portofolio karyamu dan terhubung dengan rekan proyek se-kampus"
- Tombol Utama SSO Kampus: "Masuk dengan SSO / SIAKAD Kampus" dengan ikon key dan badge aman
- Divider elegan: "atau masuk dengan kredensial akun"
- Form input:
  * NIM / Email Mahasiswa Kampus (e.g. mahasiswa@students.ac.id) dengan ikon mail
  * Kata Sandi dengan ikon lock dan tombol toggle visibilitas kata sandi
- Baris opsi: Checkbox "Ingat Saya di Perangkat Ini" dan link "Lupa Kata Sandi?"
- Tombol CTA Primer: "Masuk ke Akun" (warna Indigo #4338ca)
- Bagian bawah: "Belum memiliki akun mahasiswa? Daftar Sekarang" yang mengarah ke registrasi
- Banner jaminan keamanan data akademik berstandar kampus di bagian footer (ikon shield).

item.title: Onboarding Setup Profil & Keahlian
item.prompt:
Halaman Onboarding Setup Profil, Minat, dan Keahlian Mahasiswa untuk aplikasi CampusFolio (langkah setelah registrasi akun baru).
Desain mobile modern bertema Academic Modernist tanpa emoji kasual, menggunakan ikon Material Symbols Outlined.
Elemen halaman:
- Progress bar langkah (Langkah 2 dari 3: Personalisasi Profil & Minat)
- Judul: "Atur Keahlian & Minat Proyek", Subjudul: "Bantu algoritma AI merekomendasikan rekan tim dan proyek lomba yang sesuai dengan kompetensimu"
- Foto Profil / Avatar: area upload foto formal/semi-formal kampus dengan badge ikon photo_camera
- Bio Singkat Akademik (textarea: maks 150 karakter)
- Pilihan Role & Minat Utama (chip selector dengan ikon rapi):
  * UI/UX Design, Frontend Development, Mobile Flutter, Backend API, Machine Learning / AI, Data Science, IoT & Embedded Systems, Product Management
- Input Tag Keahlian Spesifik (chips yang bisa ditambahkan: Figma, React, Python, TensorFlow, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL)
- Preferensi Kolaborasi (radio/card selection):
  * "Aktif Mencari Tim (Lomba / PKM)"
  * "Terbuka untuk Kolaborasi Proyek"
  * "Fokus Belajar & Showcase Portofolio"
- Tombol navigasi: "Lewati Sementara" dan tombol primer "Simpan & Lanjutkan ke Beranda" (ikon arrow_forward).

designSystem.styleGuidelines:
## Brand & Style
The design system embodies an Academic Modernist sensibility: disciplined, intellectual, authoritative, yet thoroughly adapted to modern mobile contexts. It balances the structural rigor of classical university publishing with the tactile efficiency of contemporary product design.

- **Brand Personality**: Scholarly, precise, high-trust, deliberate, and archival.
- **Target Audience**: Researchers, university faculty, postgraduates, and academic professionals who demand uncompromised legibility and density without clutter.
- **Emotional Response**: Cultivates deep focus, institutional credibility, and clarity of thought.
- **Design Style**: Neoclassical editorial modernism. Crisp rules, structural grid lines, subdued ink-inspired tones, strict typographic hierarchies, and zero non-functional ornamentation. Strict avoidance of casual emojis or juvenile elements; semantic clarity is achieved strictly via Material Symbols Outlined icons and typographic inflection.

## Layout & Spacing
A fluid 4-column layout on mobile devices transitions to an 8-column layout on tablets and a 12-column fixed-max layout for reading dashboards.

- **Rhythm**: Built on a strict 4px/8px incremental base unit.
- **Density**: Moderately dense to support scientific metadata (authorship, DOI indices, affiliations), while preserving generous 26px line height for reading blocks.
- **Mobile Margins**: Standardized to `1rem` (16px) outer safe margin on mobile, ensuring edge-to-edge readability without cognitive strain.
- **Reflow Behavior**: Metadata blocks collapse into vertical stacks with subtle divider rules on screens below 480px.

## Elevation & Depth
Elevation favors print-like architectural layering over decorative drop shadows.

- **Primary Technique**: Crisp structural hairlines (`1px solid #e2e8f0`) and subtle tonal stratification (`#fcfcfb` base to `#ffffff` surface containers).
- **Shadow Profiles**: Ambient, almost unperceived diffuse ink shadows (`0 1px 3px rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.05), 0 4px 12px rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.03)`). No colored glows or blur-heavy effects.
- **Depth Hierarchy**:
  - *Layer 0 (Canvas)*: `#fcfcfb` paper ground.
  - *Layer 1 (Card / Tile)*: `#ffffff` with a `1px solid #e2e8f0` stroke.
  - *Layer 2 (Floating Action / Sticky App Bar)*: `#ffffff` surface with a bottom border rule and 8px diffuse ambient shadow.
  - *Layer 3 (Modals / Drawers)*: Crisp modal containers with a deep 24px backdrop scrim (`rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.4)`).

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary**: Solid Indigo (`#4338ca`) background, crisp white label text in `Hanken Grotesk` (Weight 600), 4px border radius. Padding: 10px 16px. Touch target height: 44px minimum.
- **Secondary / Outlined**: Transparent background, `1px solid #cbd5e1` outline, `#312e81` label.
- **Icon Pairing**: Leading or trailing Material Symbols Outlined icons at 18px size, strictly monochrome to match the text token.

### Form Inputs & Search
- Surface: `#ffffff` background with a `1px solid #cbd5e1` border, transitioning to `1.5px solid #4338ca` upon focus.
- Typography: Input text set in `Hanken Grotesk` 15px; placeholders set in `#64748b` italic.
- Prefix: Material Symbols Outlined (`search`, `filter_list`, `library_books`) anchored with 12px left padding.

### Chips & Metadata Tags
- Height: 24px–28px, 4px border radius.
- Inactive / Taxonomy: `#f1f5f9` surface with `1px solid #e2e8f0` border and `#334155` text in `label-sm`.
- Active / Citation: Light Indigo tint (`#eef2ff`) with `#4338ca` text and a subtle indigo outline. Emojis are strictly banned; status is expressed through icons like `verified`, `bookmark`, or `school`.

### Cards & Abstract Tiles
- Grounded in `#ffffff` with a standard `1px solid #e2e8f0` boundary.
- Internal padding: `1.25rem` (`space-lg`).
- Layout: Publication metadata (journal name, issue, DOI) rendered in `label-sm` along the top bar; article title rendered in `headline-md` (`Source Serif 4`); abstract snippet rendered in `body-sm` (`Newsreader`).

### Lists & Citations
- Non-bordered or hairline divider (`1px solid #f1f5f9`) separators.
- Numerical indices styled with tabular numbers in `label-md` `#4338ca`.
- Interaction: Gentle hover/pressed state using `#f8fafc`.

### Checkboxes & Radios
- Square checkbox (4px radius) and crisp circular radio.
- Unchecked: `1.5px solid #94a3b8`.
- Checked: `#4338ca` fill with a pure white checkmark or center pip.

### Academic-Specific Additions
- **Citation Callout**: Left-bordered callout panel (`3px solid #4338ca`) on a tinted `#f8fafc` background for highlighted quotes and bibliography excerpts.
- **DOI Pill**: Compact monospace-style data indicator pairing the `link` Material Symbols Outlined icon with selectable publication handles.
